entries.answer:
A kérdésed ("Ez mi?") jelenleg kontextus nélküli számomra. Nem látok csatolt fájlt, képet, vagy korábbi beszélgetést, amire utalnál.

Kérlek, pontosítsd:
 Van csatolt kép, dokumentum vagy fájl? Ha igen, kérlek töltsd fel újra, vagy magyarázd el, mit látsz/láttál.
 Egy korábbi beszélgetésre utalsz? Ha korábban másik ablakban vagy eszközzel beszélgettünk, kérlek ismertesd a témát.
 Egy konkrét tárgyra, jelenségre, szóra vagy fogalomra gondolsz? Írd le részletesebben, mi az, amit meg szeretnél érteni.

Ha van konkrét témád, szívesen részletes, alapos választ adok magyarul, de ehhez szükségem van arra, hogy tudjam: miről beszélünk.

entries.query: Your task is to take the provided technical description and rewrite it as a single, comprehensive prompt. Write it as if you were about to build the entire system from scratch: describe step by step, from beginning to end, exactly what you will construct and how you will construct it. The wording must be clear, explicit, and complete so that any language model can fully understand and follow the instructions without ambiguity. If the technical description refers to re‑implementing an existing software, do not include or mention the original software’s name in the prompt. Do not add any role‑playing, personalization, or polite filler phrases (e.g., ‘You are a software developer’, ‘As an expert’, ‘Please kindly’). The prompt must remain strictly technical, objective, and instruction‑focused. Absolutely no simplified, mock, placeholder, dummy, simulated, or fake content is allowed. You must require the full application with all files, in complete, unabridged, production‑ready code. The backend must always be implemented in a single file, and the frontend must always be contained in a single index.html file, including all subpages.
entries.answer:
Ez a szöveg egy metaprompt generátorhoz szóló rendszerutasítás. Vagyis maga a feladat leírása az, hogy hogyan kell egy másik, technikai leírásból teljes, egyértelmű, produkciókész promptot írni. Pontosan az alábbi formában adható át bármely nyelvi modellnek:



 A prompt

Take the following technical description and transform it into a single, comprehensive, selfcontained implementation prompt. The output prompt must describe, step by step and in full detail, every component of the system that needs to be built, covering architecture, data flow, logic, file structure, API contracts, UI behavior, and all edge cases, from the very first line of code to a fully operational application.

The output prompt must adhere to the following strict constraints:

Language and tone: The prompt must be written in clear, precise, unambiguous technical English. Every instruction must be explicit and leave no room for interpretation. No roleplaying framing, no personalization, no polite filler phrases, and no motivational language is permitted. The prompt must read as a purely technical specification.

Completeness: The prompt must describe the full application without omission. Every feature, every endpoint, every UI element, every database schema, every business rule, and every validation constraint mentioned or implied in the technical description must appear in the output prompt in unambiguous, actionable terms.

No placeholder content: The prompt must not request, suggest, or permit simplified, mock, dummy, simulated, placeholder, or fake implementations of any kind. Every piece of logic, data handling, authentication, storage, and rendering must be fully real and productionready. Comments such as "TODO", "add logic here", "replace with real data", or any equivalent are explicitly forbidden in the resulting code.

Backend file structure: The entire backend must be implemented in a single file. Specify the exact programming language and runtime environment. Define every route, handler, middleware, database connection, authentication mechanism, session management strategy, environment variable usage, and error handling block within that single file. The file must be deployable without modification.

Frontend file structure: The entire frontend, including all pages, subpages, navigation logic, forms, modals, state management, and styling, must be contained in a single index.html file. All JavaScript must be inline or in a <script> block within the same file. All CSS must be inline or in a <style> block within the same file. No external build tools, bundlers, or separate asset files are permitted. The application must be functional by opening index.html directly in a browser or serving it as a static file.

Original software references: If the technical description refers to, is inspired by, or reimplements any existing software product, platform, tool, or service, the output prompt must not mention, name, or reference that original software in any way. The implementation must be described entirely on its own terms.

Architecture description order: The output prompt must describe the system in the following order: (1) highlevel overview of what the system does and what problem it solves, (2) complete data model with all entities, fields, types, and relationships, (3) backend implementation with every endpoint, authentication flow, business logic, and persistence layer, (4) frontend implementation with every screen, component, interaction, routing behavior, and API integration, (5) configuration and environment setup, (6) acceptance criteria listing every functional requirement that the finished system must satisfy.

Production readiness: The output prompt must explicitly require that the delivered code handles all error states, validates all inputs on both frontend and backend, uses secure practices for authentication and data storage, and is ready to run in a production environment without further modification.

Apply this transformation to the technical description provided by the user. Output only the resulting prompt, with no preamble, no explanation, and no commentary before or after it.
